worldcombat.skill.heatwave.summary: Warms a breath in its chest and exhales it forward: a fan of hot wind pushes across the ground, scalding everyone it sweeps and shoving them away from the caster, with a chance to set them alight. Fiercer in harsh sun, weaker in rain, and it leaves nothing behind.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.use.0: Scald several enemies in the fan ahead
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.use.1: Shove a charging group out of position
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.use.2: Reach full force under harsh sunlight
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.use.3: Lay down a readable cone of pressure
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.description.0: The gust deals %1$s special damage to each body it sweeps; their special defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.description.1: A fan %1$s blocks long with a %2$s degree opening sweeps out over %3$s s, pushing everyone it catches out of position.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.description.2: A body it catches has a %1$s chance to be set alight and is pushed about %2$s blocks away from the caster.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.description.3: which also drive the on-screen density.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.gale.on: Gale: a wider fan that pushes farther and sweeps faster, at the cost of x0.88 power, x0.85 ignition and -2 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.gale.off: Scorch: x1.12 power and x1.15 ignition, but a narrower fan, a shorter push and +4 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.growth.0: From level %1$s the gust rises to %2$s power and %3$s ignition chance.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.growth.1: From level %1$s the gust rises to %2$s power and the reach to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.preference.ga: On: a wider fan that pushes farther and sweeps faster, but x0.88 power, x0.85 ignition and -2 cooldown, for shoving a group aside. Off (scorch): x1.12 power and x1.15 ignition, but a narrower fan, a shorter push and +4 cooldown, for burning.
worldcombat.skill.heatwave.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target with other enemies nearby ranks first so the fan catches them too; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
world_combat.move.heatwave.text.burn: Set alight by the hot wind
